source.name: Theorems about the definitions of the moments of a grid, checked by Lean
source.how: each expected value is proved to be the value of the feature's definition at the doubles nearest the stored values, or within half a unit in its last place of it, by the theorem its record names in spec/XtractSpec/Records/Grid.lean; written by tests/reference/generate/lean_grid.py and checked by Lean's kernel

tolerance.reason: no rounding: every value is a multiple of 1/4 and every column and row is a whole number, so each product and each addition is exact; the expected value is exact

67 roundings, each within 2^-53 relatively: for a moment, at most three multiplications by a column in every term, the W - 1 additions along a row, at most three multiplications of the sum of a row by its row and the H - 1 additions of the rows, all of one sign; and the expected value
